title: baccharis caespitosa var. alpina
intro: Baccharis caespitosa var. alpina, commonly known as Alpina Groundsel, is a plant species in the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpina Groundsel are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial effects, suggesting its potential use in treating infections and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Baccharis caespitosa var. alpina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
